from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PerShareMetric(BaseModel):
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company or entity reported in this filing")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line-item label for the per-share value (e.g., 'Net loss per share', 'Distributable income per unit')")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the metric; negative values indicate a loss")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period end date or description")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the metric in the text")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    per_share_metrics: list[PerShareMetric]
